[LIMP.13.2] **Past the source, a schema's own name is its only name.** The
compiler must write it wherever an artefact names a schema ([RDSC.5.2]). A
recording carries it ([RFCS.6.2]), a `FactExternal` carries it ([RFCS.23.3]), and
a host names a schema by it ([NFCT.1.4.2]). An `as` alias and a `lib.Schema`
reference are spellings in one source file, and neither reaches an artefact.

A rule therefore reads, emits and answers one schema, and a slot refers to one
([LIMP.1.5]), whatever a file calls it, and two distinct schemas a file holds under two aliases stay two schemas
([LIMP.2.1.7]).
